content:
incident-bot: SEV2 alert — increased tail latency + 5xx spike for hosted text-gen API (us-west-2). Symptoms: elevated p50->p99 token latency, burst of 503s and model fallback errors. Paging oncall. Monitoring dashboard: https://mon/redwood/alerts/1765436789 :rotating_light:

maria: I'm oncall, taking this. Noted customer-facing errors coming in via support. Starting triage — will collect scope and try quick mitigations.

kevin: I'm online, joining. I'll grab runtime logs and kernel OOM traces. Can someone post customer list?

lia: support update — 3 customers reported timeouts in last 12m (acct: acme-inc, boltlytics, demo-team). Support ticket 9876 attached. SLA impact looks limited but visible.

sanjay: initial read from metrics: sudden spike in KV cache invalidations ~11:03:22 -> lots of cold starts for model shards. Memory pressure on infer hosts, autoscaler failing to add new nodes quickly. Hypothesis: cache storm + autoscaler cooldown.

ashley: observability snippet (tail of redis/kv-cache logs):
```
2026-06-12T11:02:59Z WARN eviction triggered key=prefix-usr-12 size=3.4MB
2026-06-12T11:03:05Z INFO set prefix-usr-45 ttl=3600
2026-06-12T11:03:12Z ERR conn-limit rejected client=10.2.3.45
```

kevin: running query for host OOMs now. If memory pressure is root cause, short mitigation is to route traffic to fallback smaller model variant and reduce per-request concurrency.

maria: Agreed. Plan for live mitigation (fast):
• route 100% of new requests in us-west-2 for text-gen-> curated/ggml-small:quant-v1 (memory-friendly)
• reduce max_concurrency on hostpool from 8 -> 4 temporarily
• enable prefix-KV caching for steady workloads
I'll coordinate the rollout and watch error budget.

sanjay: command I'm going to run:
```
# switch model routing to quantized-small for region
redwood route set --region us-west-2 --service text-gen --model curated/ggml-small:quant-v1 --weight 100 --reason "mitigation - kv-cache storm" --until 1765440000
# reduce concurrency
redwood pool update --pool infer-usw2 --max-concurrency 4
```

ops-triage-bot: ACTION: routing change started by sanjay. Change id: rc-20260612-01. Patch propagation ETA ~30s.

eng-oncall-bot: Deployment watchdog: rolling changes applied to 80% of nodes. Fallback throttling metrics may lag 20-40s.

kevin: confirmed new routing in the control plane. Kernel OOM traces dropping. Host memory reclaim stabilizing. p99 latency trending down.

maria: customer impact update: support sees successful retries for most requests after switch, two customers still seeing intermittent 502s — engineering to follow up.

lia: escalating to account execs for acme-inc and boltlytics, cc'ing success. Lia to follow up externally.

jordan: next steps for post-incident follow-up: can we lock in a postmortem slot tomorrow? Need owner, short timeline, and a remediation tracker. Also request a brown-bag shareout for SRE + Platform teams.

maria: I can own the postmortem. Proposed time: tomorrow 11:00 PT (1765513200). Agenda: timeline, root cause, remediation plan, runbook updates.

kevin: I'll own deep-dive on memory/kv interaction (action: investigate autoscaler cooldown threshold and shard eviction patterns). ETA EOD Fri.

ashley: I'll update observability dashboards — add a dedicated KV-cache eviction panel and an alert for eviction-rate > 50/min. ETA: 48h.

sanjay: I'll follow up on routing policy — add a safer gradual rollout step and automatic fallback whitelist. Action: create PR to change default rollout window. ETA: 3 days.

maria: created postmortem doc + action tracker: https://docs.redwood/postmortems/1765436789-ops-handoff. Tracker table (quick):
- ACTION-1 | Owner: kevin | Investigate autoscaler cooldown -> due 2026-06-16 | status: in progress
- ACTION-2 | Owner: ashley | Add eviction alert & dashboard -> due 2026-06-14 | status: open
- ACTION-3 | Owner: sanjay | Routing rollout safeties PR -> due 2026-06-19 | status: open
- ACTION-4 | Owner: lia | Customer follow-ups & SLO notice -> due 2026-06-13 | status: in progress
(Full tracker in doc)

jordan: For org learnings: propose 30m brown-bag next week (SRE+Platform) focused on "Cache eviction storms and safe rollouts". Suggested speakers: maria, kevin, ashley. I'll create the invite once owners confirm.

lia: confirm — I'll coordinate customer comms draft with success/px.

maria: quick retro note — immediate mitigation worked, but we should reduce blast radius for model routing changes and improve autoscaler responsiveness. Add to postmortem.

eng-oncall-bot: Mitigation complete — system metrics normalized, error rate back to baseline. Closing active paging status. If anything regresses reopen thread.

kevin: thanks all. Will post deep-dive logs into the doc by EOD.

ashley: adding dashboard PR link shortly.

sanjay: logging a follow-up ticket to revisit shard eviction algorithm (ENG-8721).

maria: meeting invite sent for postmortem tomorrow 11:00 PT. Brown-bag tentative invite sent for next Thursday 10:00 PT.

lia: thanks team :pray: — closing loop with ops and support now.

maria: great work everyone. After postmortem we should push runbook update (step: autoscaler override + emergency routing to low-mem models) and drill it in the next oncall rotation.

kevin: +1 to a drill.

(reacts: :thumbsup: from lia, :eyes: from jordan, :party: from eng-oncall-bot)
